outcome: Prevalence of filled opioid prescriptions at discharge
cohort: 508,258 postpartum women aged 15-49 years old insured by TRICARE Prime/Prime Plus between fiscal years 2010 to 2015, excluding abortive pregnancy outcomes and incomplete datasets.
finding: Women who received postpartum care in civilian facilities were more likely to fill an opioid prescription at discharge compared to those who received care in military facilities.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries occurred less frequently in military care (26%) compared with civilian care (30%), and forceps deliveries occurred more frequently in military care (1.38%) compared with civilian care (0.75%).
